title: Annotatio VI §.II close: Scripture ignores corporal/spiritual restrict; Jn 6:54–56 — before §.III
pass_a_gloss: So that nothing may be excepted here by distinguishing corporal and spiritual participation of Christ’s body and blood — inasmuch as Holy Scripture utterly ignores this restrictive distinction, and rather asserts absolutely and without restriction: that everyone who eats Christ’s flesh and drinks Christ’s blood abides in Christ, and Christ in him, and has eternal life (Jn 6:54, 56).
pass_b_english: No escape by splitting corporal vs spiritual participation: Scripture does not know that restrictive distinction.
It asserts without limit that whoever eats the flesh and drinks the blood abides in Christ and has eternal life (Jn 6:54, 56). Stop §.II before §.III (patristic class).
source_text: Ut nequicquam hic excipiatur, distinguendo inter participationem corporis & sanguinis Christi corporalem, & spiritualem, utpote distinctionem hanc restrictivam Scriptura S. prorsus ignorante, quin potius absolutè & citra restrictionem asserente: Omnem eum, qui carnem Christi edit & sanguinem Christi bibit, manere in Christo, & Christum in eo, habereque vitam æternam, Joh. 6. vers. 54. 56.
